page.overview:
Who is Lideine Rajan?

Circa , Lideine was one of more than twelve women who sat for her ajah (note the lowercase), in discussion of building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}}

From a letter dated , it is stated that Lideine has since been stilled, along with several of her followers. It is highly likely that Lideine became a renegade Aes Sedai after the talks of .

It appears she was a leader among the Aes Sedai who refused to follow Elisane Tishar, since after her stilling, most of the resistance against Elisane came to a halt.
